lines.t: Serve with hearts sincere,
Put others’ needs before your own,
Sacrifice your will and fear,
In love’s pure light you’re truly known.
Serve in love, so freely given,
A right heart brings forth glad service,
Wash each other’s feet in humility,
In serving others, find your purpose.
The Spirit of Truth will guide,
Conviction brings forth righteousness,
By serving others side by side,
You bear much fruit in sacredness.
Serve in love, so freely given,
A right heart brings forth glad service,
Wash each other’s feet in humility,
In serving others, find your purpose.
Lay down your life for those in need,
With open hands and open heart,
Embrace the call, fulfill the deed,
In loving service, play your part.
Serve in love, so freely given,
A right heart brings forth glad service,
Wash each other’s feet in humility,
In serving others, find your purpose.
